answer: In this PoA design, identity verification binds each claimed agent to a Wesolowski VDF: it must execute a prescribed chain of sequential modular squarings, with each result required for the next. An attacker simulating many clones cannot parallelize one chain across GPUs or shortcut its delay; every clone therefore incurs an independent, strict physical time bottleneck. The oasis, karst, and summit labels provide no computational advantage.
